expected_reason: The price quote cannot go out until Omer finishes the updated cost sheet, so it is blocked. Tidying the shared folder is optional housekeeping that nobody asked for and nothing depends on.

source.source_detail: demo_flow run of 2026-10-26 (slack-first). The two UUID tasks are task.created output as Inbox sent it (eval/real_output/2026-10-26_demo-slack-first/), fields kept as they came: the quote has no description and no effort estimate. Only `blocked` is set by hand, from the demo's expected answer (the quote depends on Omer's cost sheet). task_tidy_shared_folder is hand-written, with no tier and no deadline, because no real task came without a tier.
